title: Rational numbers as decimals
competency: Write rational numbers as terminating or repeating decimals, turn terminating decimals into fractions and locate rational numbers on the number line.

keywords.def: A decimal that ends, such as 0.6 or 2.375.
A decimal in which a block of digits repeats for ever, such as 0.333… or 0.2323…
A line over the repeating digits of a decimal: 0.3̅ means 0.333…
A line where every number has its own point. Numbers grow to the right.
A number that can be written a/b with integers a, b and b ≠ 0.

en.text: Divide a by b to write a/b as a decimal. Either the division stops, giving a terminating decimal like 0.6. Or the digits repeat for ever, like 0.555…. A bar over the repeating digits shows this. A terminating decimal becomes a fraction over 10, 100 or 1000.

am.text: a/bን በአስርዮሽ ለመጻፍ aን በb አካፍል። ወይ ማካፈሉ ይቆማል፤ እንደ 0.6 ያለ የሚያልቅ አስርዮሽ ይሰጣል። ወይ አሃዞቹ ለዘላለም ይደጋገማሉ፤ እንደ 0.555…። በሚደጋገሙት አሃዞች ላይ ያለ መስመር ይህንን ያሳያል። የሚያልቅ አስርዮሽ በ10፣ 100 ወይም 1000 ላይ ክፍልፋይ ይሆናል።

screens.title: Will the division stop?
screens.text: Divide 3 by 5 on paper. Then divide 5 by 9.
screens.ask: Which division do you think ends?
screens.after: Do both divisions, then read on.

screens.title: Two things can happen
paras: Any rational number a/b can be written as a decimal. Divide a by b.
The division may stop with remainder 0. Then it is a terminating decimal, such as 3/5 = 0.6.
Or the remainder never becomes 0 and the digits repeat. Then it is a repeating decimal, such as 5/9 = 0.555…
Bar notation. A bar over the repeating digits shows the repetition: 1/3 = 0.333… = 0.3̅ and 23/99 = 0.2323… = 0.2̅3̅.
screens.note: In long division, when a remainder comes back, the digits must repeat.

screens.title: Name it
defs: A block of digits repeats for ever: 5/9 = 0.555…
A bar over the repeating block: 0.555… = 0.5̅.

screens.title: Which one ends?
screens.text: Which fraction gives a terminating decimal?
screens.clue: Divide each one. Which reaches remainder 0?

screens.title: Why 1/7 repeats
screens.text: Why must the decimal for 1/7 repeat?
opts: The remainders can only be 1 to 6, so one must come back
screens.ans: The remainders can only be 1 to 6, so one must come back
screens.why: Once a remainder repeats, the same digits follow again.
screens.clue: Divide 1 by 7 and watch the remainders.

screens.title: Terminating decimals to fractions
paras: A terminating decimal can be written as a fraction.
Use one zero for each digit after the decimal point.

screens.text: Count the digits after the point. Then simplify.
steps: GCF(18, 100) = 2. Divide top and bottom by 2.

screens.title: 0.45 as a fraction
screens.text: Write 0.45 as a fraction in simplest form.
screens.why: 0.45 = 45/100. Divide top and bottom by 5 to get 9/20.
screens.clue: Two decimal digits means a denominator of 100.

screens.title: Bar notation
screens.why: 5/6 = 0.8333… Only the 3 repeats, so the bar goes over the 3.

screens.title: Birr and santim
screens.text: Kebede pays 0.25 birr for a pencil eraser.
screens.ask: As a fraction in simplest form, that is ___ birr.
screens.clue: Two digits after the point: put 25 over 100, then simplify.
screens.worked: 0.25 has two decimal digits, so 0.25 = 25/100. GCF(25, 100) = 25. So 0.25 = 1/4.

ideas.name: Rational numbers on the number line

en.text: Every rational number has a point on the number line. Integers are easy to mark. For a fraction, change it to a decimal first. For example, 4/3 = 1.333…, just past 1. And −5/2 = −2.5, halfway between −3 and −2.

am.text: እያንዳንዱ ምክንያታዊ ቁጥር በቁጥር መስመር ላይ ነጥብ አለው። ኢንቲጀሮችን ማመልከት ቀላል ነው። ክፍልፋይን መጀመሪያ ወደ አስርዮሽ ቀይር። ለምሳሌ 4/3 = 1.333… ከ1 ትንሽ ያልፋል። −5/2 = −2.5 ደግሞ በ−3 እና በ−2 መሃል ነው።

screens.title: Temperature in Debre Birhan
screens.text: One cold morning in Debre Birhan the temperature was −3/2 °C.
screens.clue: Divide 3 by 2, then keep the minus sign.
screens.worked: 3 ÷ 2 = 1.5. Keep the sign: −3/2 = −1.5. On the line, it is halfway between −2 and −1.

screens.title: Simplify 18/100
screens.text: Divide top and bottom by their GCF.
steps: Factors of 18 that also divide 100: 1 and 2.
So 18/100 = 9/50. GCF(9, 50) = 1, so it is in simplest form.
